prompt: Create a vertical comparison-result image with a clean white header occupying the top quarter and a cinematic cyberpunk portrait below. In the header, center large black sans-serif text reading GPT image 2.0 on a plain white background, with generous margins and no other graphics. Below the header, show a realistic nighttime futuristic city scene in a 3:4 vertical frame: a serious handsome dark-haired man in his early 30s standing in the foreground, cropped from chest up, slightly left of center, wearing a black leather trench coat with a high raised collar over a dark shirt. His face is moody and partly shadowed, with subtle stubble, wavy tousled hair, and his gaze turned off to the left as if alert or contemplative. The background is a rain-slick neon skyline with glass skyscrapers, mist, reflections, and strong blue and magenta lighting. On the right-side building, include exactly 2 visible neon text elements: large cyan stacked words BUILD THE FUTURE and smaller magenta text CO-FOUNDER. Add distant vertical neon signs on the left, blurred city windows, wet railings at the bottom edge, and cinematic high-contrast lighting with shallow depth of field. Use photorealistic detail, noir atmosphere, 35mm film still composition, dramatic rim light, and no logos, watermarks, or extra text beyond the header and the two building sign texts.
